title: payment.created.v1
description: A payment intent was accepted, risk-assessed and routed. Published by Payment Orchestration (BC-6) on pp.payments.payment.v1, keyed by payment_id. Creation does not mean money moved - it means the intent exists and a routing decision was made. The idempotency key is carried only as a HASH: the key is client-opaque and may embed the merchant's own identifiers, so republishing it would leak their data into every downstream consumer.

amount.description: Immutable for the life of the payment (invariant I4), enforced in the aggregate and by a database trigger.

paymentMethod.description: Domain vocabulary, never a gateway's. A gateway method string reaching this field is an anti-corruption-layer failure.

riskScore.description: 0-100. ABSENT when the external scorer was unavailable and the policy default applied - which is why it is optional rather than defaulting to 0, a value that would be indistinguishable from a genuine zero-risk score.

routingPlanId.description: Absent when routing produced no candidates, which is a legal outcome and yields NO_ELIGIBLE_GATEWAY.

candidateGateways.description: Ordered gateway codes from the routing plan.

idempotencyKeyHash.description: sha256 of the client's idempotency key. Hash, never the key.

metadataKeys.description: Key NAMES only. Merchant metadata values are not republished, because a merchant may put their own customer identifiers in them.
